{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f"Mean revenue of completed orders: {mean_revenue:.2f}")

# Confirm no QA orders
print("Number of rows with revenue = 999999.99:", (completed_orders['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum())"}
